# Task: build the contribution-prompt-builder tool

## What problem this solves

A contributor who isn't comfortable writing frontmatter by hand, or who doesn't know a given entity type's schema, connection rules, or the lawfulness constraints, still needs a way to draft a correctly-formatted entry. This tool doesn't generate the entry itself — it generates a *prompt*, which the contributor copies and pastes into whatever AI chatbot they already use (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot Chat, anything). The AI drafts the markdown; the contributor then creates/edits the file(s) via GitHub's native edit flow (the same `github.com/{org}/{repo}/edit/main/{path}` mechanism described in `scaffold-site.prompt.md` §5 — for a brand-new file, GitHub's "Create new file" UI at the equivalent path serves the same purpose). This tool's job ends at "copy the prompt" — it does not call any AI API itself, submit anything, or create/edit files on the contributor's behalf.

This is deliberate, same reasoning as the edit-link decision in `scaffold-site.prompt.md`: no backend, no API keys to manage, nothing for a small trusted team to operate or secure.

**This version generalizes the tool from books-only to all five entity types**, and specifically handles the case that motivated the generalization: someone adding a new book often doesn't just want to link to an *existing* meme or person — they want to propose a brand-new one in the same breath. The book flow below (§1) treats that as a first-class path, not an edge case bolted onto a picker.

## Where this lives

**One page**, not five — `/contribute/new`, with a type switcher at the top (書籍 / 人物 / Meme／概念 / 資源 / Context 文章). All five flows share the same data source, the same search-picker component, and the same "assemble prompt → copy" mechanism; only the form fields and the generated prompt's content differ per type. Splitting this into five separate pages would just duplicate all of that plumbing five times for no benefit.

Linked from `CONTRIBUTING.md` (every "新增 X" section links here, with `?type=` preselecting the right tab — see the `CONTRIBUTING.md` diff in this same change for the exact wording) and from the landing page's "如何貢獻" section. Don't rename the tool or change this URL without updating both.

## Shared backbone

- **Data source:** `knowledge/.generated/entity-index.json`, fetched once at page load (generated by `tools/sync.js`; shape is `{slug, title, type, path}[]` covering `book`, `meme`, `person`, `resource` — `context` entries too, per that file's own spec). Static JSON fetch, client-side filtering — no server, no search backend, no per-flow refetching.
- **Search-picker component:** one reusable widget, parameterized by which `type`(s) to filter to. Used everywhere a flow needs "search existing X and pick one or more." Note its one real limitation: it only searches actual cataloged entities, **not** the plain-name-string placeholders sitting inside other books' `authors:`/`people:`/`availability.physical_access[].name` fields — those aren't indexed anywhere, so a contributor identifying "this person/resource already appears in another book" has to do that by memory or by searching `knowledge/books/` themselves, not through this picker. Say this plainly in the UI wherever it's relevant (§2 and §4 below) rather than implying the picker is exhaustive.
- **Prompt assembly:** plain client-side string templating per flow, same as the original book-only version. No templating library needed.
- **Raw GitHub URLs, not rendered pages:** every schema/instructions/template reference in every generated prompt is a `raw.githubusercontent.com/...` URL, not a site page — the target AI needs to read actual file content.

---

## §1. 新增書籍 (Book)

### Form

1. **新書基本資料** — title (required), type (fiction/non-fiction, required), author name if known, year/ISBN/publisher if known. Anything left blank becomes an explicit `<!-- verify -->` instruction in the generated prompt, not a silent omission.
2. **連結方式 (How this book connects)** — a repeatable list, **at least one entry required from options A/B/C/E below** (D alone does not satisfy the requirement — see the note under D):
   - **A. 使用現有 meme** — search picker over `meme` entities.
   - **B. 建議新增 meme** — free-text field describing the connecting concept in the contributor's own words. The generated prompt asks the target AI to judge whether this genuinely warrants a new meme file before drafting one, and to draft it per §3's fact-based/original-argument branching (ask the contributor which one applies, or have the AI judge from the description and flag its judgment for review — either is acceptable, but the branching must not be skipped).
   - **C. 使用現有人物 slug** — search picker over `person` entities, plus a field for whether this person is the book's `authors:` or `people:` (see `people.instructions.md` for the distinction — don't let the contributor conflate them).
   - **D. 人物係新面孔，呢本書係佢喺知識庫嘅第一次出現** — just a plain-text name field, no picker. **Show a visible note here**: per `books.instructions.md`, a plain-name placeholder that doesn't match an existing person page does *not* by itself satisfy the "no isolated entries" rule — this option alone does not let the contributor proceed to generate a prompt; they still need at least one of A/B/C/E too.
   - **E. 人物已經喺其他現有書出現過（未有獨立頁面），而家想順便升級佢做正式人物頁** — this is a **promotion**, and it's a compound action: it produces a new person page *and* requires editing that other existing book too, not just this one. Selecting this expands an inline mini-form: a search field for the other existing book (free search over `book` entities — remember the picker can't find the plain-name reference itself, the contributor has to know which book), plus the same name/name_en/born/roles/themes fields as the standalone person flow in §2. Prefer directing contributors who already know this to the standalone §2 flow instead, since it's the same outcome with a form built for exactly this — offer this inline path mainly so someone who started here doesn't have to lose their in-progress book form to go do it separately.
3. **Optional enrichment (not required to generate a prompt):**
   - `related_books:` — search picker over `book` entities + a relation dropdown (`fictionalizes` / `responds_to` / `inherits` / `criticizes`). See `books.instructions.md`: don't guess a relation you're not confident about; leaving this off entirely is fine.
   - `availability:` — ecopy status (available/unavailable/unknown), and if unavailable, at least one physical-access entry (type/name, optional url/notes). If the same resource is likely to recur, mention in the UI that repeated resources should eventually promote to §4, but don't block prompt generation on that — it's a follow-up action, not a prerequisite.

**Enforce the policy in the UI itself, not just in prose**: the "generate prompt" / "copy" action stays disabled until at least one of A/B/C/E has a selection. This is the same "compliant by construction" principle `docs/spec.md` §6 describes for `tools/new-book.js`.

### Generated prompt

```
我想為 hongkong-book.md 新增一本書的條目，請按照以下規格為我生成完整、格式正確的 Markdown 檔案內容。

## 新書資料
- 書名：{{book_title}}
- 類型：{{fiction_or_nonfiction}}
- 作者（如已知）：{{author_or_請標記verify}}
- 其他已知資料：{{year_isbn_etc_or_請標記verify}}

## 連結規定（必須遵守）
本知識庫規定：新增書籍必須透過 `memes:`（附關聯類型 relation）或指向現有人物頁面的 `authors:`/`people:` slug，
連結至知識庫中至少一項現有條目，不可以是孤立條目。純文字、未對應現有人物頁面的作者姓名佔位符，本身不算滿足此規定。

本次連結安排：
{{#每一個已選的連結方式，重複以下其中一種區塊}}

{{# A. 現有 meme}}
- 使用現有 meme「{{meme_title}}」（slug: {{meme_slug}}），完整內容：{{meme_raw_github_url}}。
  請在該書的 memes: 加入 {slug: "{{meme_slug}}", relation: "..."}，relation 請你依書中實際論述判斷是
  exemplifies／originates／subverts／critiques 何者，各自定義見 schemas/book.schema.json。

{{# B. 建議新增 meme}}
- 建議新增一個 meme，主題為：{{contributor_free_text_description}}——請你先判斷這是否真的值得成為獨立 meme
  條目（而非隨手加標籤），並在回覆開頭簡短說明理由，再繼續生成內容。若判斷成立，請同時生成：
  (1) 新 meme 檔案完整內容（依 memes.instructions.md 的 fact-based／original-argument 判斷，若屬本站原創論述，
      「## What it is」開頭必須有明確聲明——見該檔案「Fact-based memes vs. original-argument memes」一節，
      不可以一般事實的語氣陳述）；
  (2) 新書的 memes: 應包含的對應項目（relation 請你自行判斷）。

{{# C. 現有人物}}
- 使用現有人物「{{person_name}}」（slug: {{person_slug}}），完整內容：{{person_raw_github_url}}。
  請加入新書的 {{authors_or_people}}: 欄位（{{authors_or_people}} 的意義分別見 people.instructions.md）。

{{# D. 新面孔人物（僅供備註，不構成連結）}}
- 新書作者「{{new_person_plain_name}}」暫時未有獨立人物頁面，請以純文字方式填入 authors:（或 people:）
  作為佔位符即可，不需要生成人物頁面。

{{# E. 人物升級}}
- 人物「{{person_plain_name}}」已在現有書籍《{{other_existing_book_title}}》中以純文字方式出現（該書完整內容：
  {{other_existing_book_raw_github_url}}），現在此人已符合升級為正式人物頁面的門檻（2 本或以上書籍），
  請同時生成：
  (1) 新人物頁面完整內容（依 people.schema.json 及 people.instructions.md，已知資料：
      {{name_en_born_roles_etc_or_請標記verify}}）；
  (2) 新書及《{{other_existing_book_title}}》兩者的 authors:/people: 應如何從純文字佔位符改為
      slug: "{{new_person_slug}}" 的具體修改建議（後者是對現有檔案的修改，不是新檔案）。

{{/重複結束}}

{{#如有選填 related_books}}

（fictionalizes／responds_to／inherits／criticizes 之一，定義見 schemas/book.schema.json）。
請加入 related_books: 欄位，只需在本書單方宣告，不需要同時修改對方書籍。

## 合法性規則（務必遵守，不可妥協）
- 絕對不可以逐字重製書籍原文內容，包括不可以用引用區塊呈現長段原文。
- 摘要與分析必須是你的原創文字，不可以貼近原文的句式、段落結構。
- 若對年份、ISBN、出版社等事實沒有把握，請將該欄位留空，並加上 <!-- verify --> 註解，不要臆測填寫。
- 依三層深度格式撰寫（30-Second Overview／5-Minute Summary／Why It Matters），並在「Why It Matters」一節中
  具體論證本書與上述連結對象之間的實質關係——不是隨意提及兩者都存在，而是要有站得住腳的論證。

## 輸出格式
若本次只涉及新書本身（連結方式只選了 A／C／D），請直接輸出該書的完整 Markdown 檔案內容。
若本次還涉及新增 meme（選項 B）、新增人物頁面，或修改現有書籍（選項 E），請將每一個檔案的內容分開清楚標示，
例如用「### 檔案一：{{path}}」「### 檔案二：{{path}}」這種格式，並在每個標題下方註明該檔案是「新建」還是
「修改現有檔案」，修改現有檔案時只需列出需要新增/更動的部分，不需要整份重寫。我會逐一複製並依實際情況以
GitHub「新增檔案」或「編輯檔案」功能建立/提交 Pull Request。
```

## §2. 新增人物 (Person) — a promotion flow, not a blank-page flow

Per `people.instructions.md`, a person only gets a real page once they connect to **2 or more** already-catalogued books. So this flow isn't "describe a person from scratch" — it's "confirm the 2-book bar is met, then promote."

### Form

1. **識別至少 2 本現有書籍** — search picker over `book` entities, multi-select, minimum 2. Remind the contributor (per the shared-backbone caveat) that the picker searches book titles, not the plain-name placeholders inside them — they need to already know which books involve this person.
2. **人物資料** — name (required, zh-HK), name_en, born (year, or `<!-- verify -->` if unsure — never guess), died (only if applicable — omit the field entirely otherwise, per schema), roles (free tags), themes.
3. **政治敏感度提示** — a static, non-blocking notice (not a form field): if this person's biography touches contested political or legal history, the resulting PR needs sign-off from 2 core reviewers per `EDITORIAL.md` — surfaced here so the contributor isn't surprised by review time, not something the tool can detect or gate on.

### Generated prompt

```
我想為 hongkong-book.md 的人物「{{person_name}}」建立正式人物頁面，並更新現有書籍條目。此人已在以下
{{count}} 本現有書籍中以純文字方式出現，符合升級為正式人物頁面的門檻：
- 《{{book_1_title}}》：{{book_1_raw_github_url}}
- 《{{book_2_title}}》：{{book_2_raw_github_url}}
{{...如有更多}}

## 人物資料
- 姓名（zh-HK）：{{name}}
- 英文姓名：{{name_en_or_留空}}
- 出生年份：{{born_or_請標記verify}}
- 逝世年份（如適用，否則此欄位不應出現於檔案中）：{{died_or_省略}}
- 身分／角色：{{roles_or_請標記verify}}

## 格式規範
- Schema：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/schemas/people.schema.json
- 撰寫規範：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/.github/instructions/people.instructions.md
- 空白範本：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/knowledge/people/_template.md

## 政治敏感度
若此人物的生平涉及具爭議性的政治或法律歷史，請依撰寫規範中「Political sensitivity」一節的要求：
陳述事實、註明出處，不對檢控、定罪或政治立場的正當性作出評論。

## 輸出格式
請分開清楚輸出以下內容：
### 檔案一：knowledge/people/{{建議slug}}.md（新建）
完整人物頁面 Markdown 內容。

### 檔案二：{{book_1 路徑}}（修改現有檔案）
只需列出應如何將現有純文字作者/人物姓名改為 authors:/people: 中的 slug: "{{建議slug}}"，不需整份重寫。

### 檔案三：{{book_2 路徑}}（修改現有檔案）
同上，適用於第二本書。

我會依實際情況，逐一以 GitHub「新增檔案」建立人物頁面，並以「編輯檔案」功能修改上述兩本現有書籍，
分開或合併提交 Pull Request 均可。
```

## §3. 新增 Meme／概念

### Form

1. **先檢查是否已存在** — a search box over `meme` entities, surfaced prominently before the rest of the form (not a blocking gate, since fuzzy near-duplicates won't always turn up in a simple title search, but the UI should make this the obvious first step, per `memes.instructions.md`: "Two meme files describing the same concept fragments the graph instead of connecting it").
2. **Fact-based 定 original-argument？（必選，這是整個表單最重要的一步）** — two options, framed as a real question, not a checkbox to click through:
   - **Fact-based** — this documents a verifiable historical fact (a treaty, a ban, a monument, an event). `first_documented` will be the year that fact is anchored to.
   - **Original-argument** — this proposes this project's own critical/interpretive framing, not (yet) a sourced claim. `first_documented` will be the year the framing was first proposed on this site, not a historical event.

   Get this wrong and the generated meme violates the single most-enforced convention in this knowledge base (see `AI-SESSION-HANDOFF.md`'s quality-discipline notes — this exact failure has recurred multiple times from content added outside any tooling at all). If the contributor seems unsure, default the UI toward original-argument and let the target AI's own judgment (prompted below) catch a fact-based case that was mis-selected, rather than the reverse.
3. **基本資料** — title (zh-HK), title_en, first_documented (year), themes.
4. **連結至至少一本現有書籍** — search picker over `book` entities, at least one required, each with a relation dropdown (`exemplifies` default / `originates` / `subverts` / `critiques`).

### Generated prompt

```
我想為 hongkong-book.md 新增一個 meme／概念條目，請按照以下規格生成完整、格式正確的 Markdown 檔案內容。

## 基本資料
- 標題（zh-HK）：{{title}}
- 英文標題：{{title_en}}
- 首次記錄／提出年份：{{first_documented}}
- 主題標籤：{{themes}}
- 本 meme 屬於：{{fact_based_or_original_argument}}

## 關鍵規定（務必遵守，這是本知識庫最重要的慣例）
{{#如 fact-based}}
這是一個 fact-based meme——記錄一項可查證的歷史事實。請以一般事實應有的確信語氣陳述，first_documented
是該事實本身發生／確立的年份。
{{/}}
{{#如 original-argument}}
這是一個 original-argument meme——提出本站自己的詮釋或批評框架，並非（目前）有出處可考的既有共識。
「## What it is」一節開頭必須有明確聲明：呢個係本站自行提出嘅分析框架，並非既有學術共識或已證實嘅事實，
並邀請讀者如知悉相關研究可透過 Issue／PR 補充來源。first_documented 在此情況下代表呢個框架喺本站首次被
提出嘅年份，並非歷史事件年份——請在該欄位旁加註明此點的 YAML comment。
不可以將呢個當一般事實咁陳述，唔可以模糊處理。
{{/}}

## 連結至現有書籍
- 《{{book_title}}》（{{book_raw_github_url}}），關聯類型：{{relation}}
{{...如有更多}}

## 格式規範
- Schema：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/schemas/meme.schema.json
- 撰寫規範：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/.github/instructions/memes.instructions.md
- 空白範本：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hong-Kong-Heritage-Archive/hongkong-book/refs/heads/main/knowledge/memes/_template.md

## 輸出格式
請分開輸出：
### 檔案一：knowledge/memes/{{建議slug}}.md（新建）
完整 meme 頁面內容。

### 檔案二：{{book 路徑}}（修改現有檔案）
只需列出應加入 memes: 的項目：{slug: "{{建議slug}}", relation: "{{relation}}"}，不需整份重寫。
{{...如連結多於一本書，每本各自列出}}
```

## §4. 新增資源 (Resource) — a promotion flow, same shape as §2

Per `resources.instructions.md`, same 2-book bar as people. Form and generated prompt mirror §2 closely:

### Form

1. **識別至少 2 本現有書籍**（引用同一資源的 availability.physical_access）— same picker/caveat as §2.
2. **資源資料** — name (zh-HK, should match the name string already used in those books), name_en, type (library/lending-app/bookstore/other), url.

### Generated prompt

Same structure as §2's, adapted:

```
## 輸出格式
```

## §5. 新增 Context 文章 (era / place / theme)

### Form

1. **類型** — era / place / theme (required).
2. **標題**（zh-HK，required）。
3. **題材是否具政治或歷史爭議性？** — yes/no. Per `context.instructions.md`: if unsure, default to yes, since it's easier for a reviewer to remove the `## Perspectives` section than to retrofit it. If yes, the generated prompt requires a `## Perspectives` section with distinct viewpoints labeled by source tradition, and the UI should show a non-blocking notice that this triggers the same 2-core-reviewer sign-off as a contested person entry (§2) or a book's "Why It Matters."
4. **相關現有書籍（選填）** — search picker over `book` entities, multi-select, not required — `context.schema.json` doesn't mandate linked books, but an essay that cites and links to none defeats its own stated purpose ("cite and link to relevant books as further reading" per `docs/spec.md` §2), so surface this as strongly encouraged rather than optional-and-easy-to-skip.

### Generated prompt

```

立場／來源傳統（例如：官方／殖民史觀點、本地民間觀點、學術批評觀點），不可以其中一種敘事作為中立事實
呈現。（此類條目在提交 PR 後，須經兩位核心審核者聯署方可合併——這是給你的提示，不需要寫入檔案內容。）
{{/}}
```

## What not to do

- Don't call any AI API from this tool, for any of the five flows. It assembles text; it doesn't generate content.
- Don't let it submit a PR, create a file, or write to the repo in any way — copy-to-clipboard is the entire output, for every flow, including the multi-file promotion flows (§1's option E, §2, §4). The contributor still does every GitHub action by hand.
- Don't skip the "disable until connected" enforcement in §1 — a prompt-builder that happily generates a prompt for an isolated book just moves the policy violation one step upstream instead of preventing it. Specifically: don't treat §1 option D (new-face placeholder) as satisfying the requirement on its own — it doesn't, and the UI must not let it.
- Don't skip the fact-based/original-argument branch in §3 or silently default one way without asking — this is the most-violated convention in the project's history per `AI-SESSION-HANDOFF.md`, and a tool meant to prevent format mistakes shouldn't itself introduce this one.
- Don't hardcode the list of existing books/memes/people/resources/context essays anywhere — it must come from the generated entity index, or it goes stale the moment a new entry merges.
- Don't build §2/§4 (person/resource promotion) as single-file outputs — the whole point of these flows is that a promotion is at minimum a 3-file change (new page + 2 existing books edited), and a generated prompt that only produces the new page silently leaves the two source books still pointing at a plain-name string instead of the new slug.
